updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.5.16 
- F-14/AIRIO update pass summary: refreshed Jester script mappings and command coverage across radar, weapons, LANTIRN, datalink, TACAN, NAV/utility, and F-14B(U)-specific behaviors (including CMDS/defensive and GGW/JDAM support).
- AIRIO command architecture summary: modernized command wiring and labels/hints, added module-aware routing/validation, added new context-key flows (including EGI direct waypoint), and improved proxy sequence reliability/timing handling.
- OpenKneeboard summary: expanded AI CREW keyword/section rendering for Tomcat commands, improved grouping/categories, and tightened AI CREW vs GND CREW separation behavior.
- Profile/runtime summary: improved profile deployment/update flow (including auto keyword finish), switched embedded profile resources handling for integrity, and updated wheel/chocks/miniwheel handling to reduce desync/visibility issues.
- Diagnostics data collection is now flight-plan-tab aware: diagnostics are gathered only when viewing the Flight Plan tab (previously tied only to OpenKneeboard being open).
- Map markers are now collected only during diagnostics collection; marker cap increased from 20 to 64 to match VAICOM server-side while avoiding non-diagnostic update overhead.
- Removed redundant opposition aircraft/helicopter build pass to avoid duplicate work during updates.
- Added additional caching in update/data paths for lower runtime overhead.
- Fixed a null-pointer issue that could prevent some units from being collected for kneeboard output.
- Added Tomcat shutdown command and sequence handling, including F-14B(U)-specific routing, cue playback, and alias registration.
- Improved AIRIO option-hint selection and EGI direct-waypoint sequencing reliability.
- Updated kneeboard AI crew keyword grouping to include Startup and Shutdown plus related categories (including Walkman and Miscellaneous).
